title: Open registration defaults on and mints owner JWTs
description: POST /auth/register is public. The production close-gate requires both ENVIRONMENT=production and ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION=false. The setting defaults true, .env.example leaves it true, and DEPLOY.md treats closing signup as a post-bootstrap step. A successful call creates an owner tenant and returns an access JWT. The web UI always exposes Register.
claimed_root_cause: allow_open_registration defaults True and register only 403s when is_production and that flag is false, so a production deploy that omits the flag keeps anonymous owner-JWT minting.

trace.description: allow_open_registration Field default True; production_must_be_safe does not require it false.
After creating Account, owner User, and General sale, register returns create_access_token for that owner.

evidence.description: 403 only if is_production and not allow_open_registration.
ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION defaults True with comment to set true only to bootstrap.
Deploy table says default true and to set false after the first real account.
Public login page posts /auth/register when mode is register.
create_access_token signs sub/account_id/role with HS256 and long default TTL.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox and parent artifact promotion unavailable

validation_plan.local: In the OS sandbox with dummy data, POST /auth/register in default development settings and expect 200+access_token; then monkeypatch is_production True and allow_open_registration False and expect 403.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner reads the deployed ALLOW_OPEN_REGISTRATION and ENVIRONMENT values (Railway variables) without creating extra live accounts.
